name: Galleonaire
description:
HOW TO JOIN - NO DEVELOPER CODE NEEDED
Install TestFlight on your iPhone, then return to https://testflight.apple.com/join/52fmzweP and open that link again. Accept the Galleonaire invitation and choose Install. If TestFlight only shows Redeem Code, return to this public invitation link instead. Requires iOS 17 or later.

Take on Galleonaire on iPhone and Apple Watch. Answer fifteen increasingly difficult questions for a fictional million-galleon prize. Explore 750 questions about Harry Potter books, films and the wider wizarding world, with fifty questions at every prize level. Correct answers move straight to the next question, with no confirmation or Next Question button. Use Fifty-Fifty, Ask the Audience and Swap Question, protect guaranteed prizes, or walk away with your winnings. Enjoy a magical quiz chamber, a redesigned prize ladder and lifelines, a developing original soundtrack, dramatic game-over music and a celebratory million-galleon fanfare. Both devices support independent offline games, a saved highest prize, personal playing statistics, native VoiceOver controls, adjustable original music, sound effects and haptics. In Settings, Background Music and Sound Effects each have their own on/off switch and independent 0-100% volume slider; set either to 0 or switch it off for silence. Individual sound previews and a separate Haptics switch help you choose what suits you. Every fresh launch opens the main menu without restoring an unfinished game. Independent fan-made quiz, not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors, publishers or film studios referenced. Galleons are fictional points with no monetary value. No advertising or analytics.
whatToTest:
THANK YOU FOR TESTING GALLEONAIRE
Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback. You are helping improve Galleonaire for blind, low-vision and sighted players.

ABOUT THE GAME
Galleonaire is an independent, fan-made Harry Potter knowledge quiz for iPhone and Apple Watch. Answer fifteen questions to win a fictional million-galleon prize. Choose from four answers and use Fifty-Fifty, Ask the Audience or Swap Question. There is no timer. Both devices can play independently offline. Galleons are game points, not real money. No account, advertising or purchase is needed.

WHAT IS NEW
- 150 additional questions, bringing the collection to 750: fifty at every prize level.
- Rebalanced difficulty across the existing collection. The final 500,000 and one-million-galleon rounds now draw from specialist expert questions. Earlier rounds build towards that challenge.
- Polished question wording, explicit book and chapter references for the additions, clearer explanations and year ranges written for speech. A spelling-only question that sounded identical with VoiceOver has been replaced.
- A richer magical quiz presentation, framed answers, distinct lifeline seals and a redesigned prize ladder. Each ladder item announces its position clearly, such as 10 of 15.
- An original background score lasting over three minutes, a distinctive final-question cue and three strong, separated loss haptic beats. Existing VoiceOver and music mixing is unchanged.
- A Statistics tab showing accuracy, wins, questions answered, streaks and lifeline use. These new statistics start with this update on each device; earlier games are not invented. Your existing highest prize and seen-question history are kept.

CUSTOMISE OR SILENCE THE AUDIO
In Settings, Background Music and Sound Effects each have their own on/off switch and independent volume slider from 0 to 100%. Make either quieter, switch either off completely, or turn both off. Zero volume also means off. Preview individual sounds at your chosen effects volume. Haptics have a separate switch. Please check that choices are remembered and sync between paired devices.

PLEASE TEST
1. Play through the ladder and tell us whether difficulty rises appropriately. The last two rounds should challenge expert fans. Report any duplicate fact, unclear question or incorrect answer with the full question and the relevant book or film.
2. With VoiceOver enabled, a correct answer should move directly to the next question without reading a random answer first. Swipe left to revisit the previous answer and explanation as a separate item. Check the prize ladder, lifelines, statistics and navigation on both devices.
3. Review the magical visuals, contrast and brief green/red result glow. Text uses normal sizing by default and follows your Apple text-size settings; also try larger accessibility text and Zoom if you use them. Try Reduce Motion and Dim Flashing Lights: animated result glows should stop while text and symbols remain clear.
4. Listen to the developing music and final-question cue. Check whether the longer loss vibration is clear on a real iPhone and Apple Watch. Try mute, both volume sliders, sound previews and Haptics Off.
5. Try winning, losing, walking away, swapping questions and restarting. Check statistics after relaunching. A fresh launch returns to the menu, keeping records and settings rather than restoring an unfinished game.

Please send TestFlight feedback with your device, operating system, what happened and how to reproduce it. Screenshots are welcome where useful. Thank you again!
reviewNotes: No account, password, purchase, advertising or external service is needed to play. Start with New Game. The Watch app is embedded in the iPhone build and is playable independently. In-game galleons are fictional score points, not money, gambling or redeemable prizes. The app does not request Health, contacts, location, microphone or tracking access. Review both visual and native VoiceOver gameplay. The expanded question bank contains independently written trivia with source notes. Artwork and audio are original and the app makes no claim of official franchise affiliation.
